title: The Grand Slam
author: Mallus
rules:
This is my first attempt at puzzle setting, so I hope you enjoy! In honor of the upcoming MLB World Series, I decided to create a baseball themed puzzle for my first attempt.

Normal sudoku rules apply. The blue line is a region sum line: box borders divide it into segments, and every segment has the same sum. Digits along an arrow sum to the digit in its circle. Digits joined by a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio, and all possible black dots are given. Digits joined by a white dot are consecutive; not all white dots are given.

You can play the puzzle here: https://sudokupad.app/4qs96m20gt
solutionCode: Row 7 from left to right, followed by column 6 from top to bottom.
